options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: networks
options.description: List of networks and what type of access they have to the SNMP servers running on the cluster nodes. This parameter is required if SNMP v3 is disabled.

options.name: snmp_v3_enabled
options.description: Which version of SNMP has to be enabled.

options.name: state
options.description: This module enables you to enable SNMP on cluster nodes. When you enable SNMP,           the action applies to all nodes in the cluster, and the values that are passed replace,           in whole, all values set in any previous call to this module.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).

options.name: usm_users
options.description: List of users and the type of access they have to the SNMP servers running on the cluster nodes. This parameter is required if SNMP v3 is enabled.
